Analysis of performance information to understand results, trends, causes, implications, and needed actions.
A selected improvement need given precedence based on importance, gap, risk, objectives, and available resources.
Specific actions, resources, responsibilities, and time horizons used to accomplish an objective.
Assignment of financial, workforce, facility, time, or other resources needed to carry out selected actions.
